Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface UserService

All Known Implementing Classes:
UserServiceImpl
public interface UserService
Service interface for user management operations. This interface defines the contract for comprehensive user lifecycle management including registration, authentication, profile management, role assignment, and user data operations.

Key service areas include:

  • User Registration invalid input: '&' Confirmation: Email-based registration with confirmation workflow
  • Profile Management: User profile updates, password changes, and profile picture management
  • Role invalid input: '&' Manager Assignment: Bulk manager assignments and role management operations
  • User Retrieval invalid input: '&' Filtering: Advanced user search and filtering capabilities
  • Password Management: Secure password reset and change functionality
  • Statistics invalid input: '&' Reporting: User management statistics and analytics

This service integrates with email utilities for notifications, file storage for profile pictures, and authorization services to ensure proper access controls throughout user operations.

    • registerUser

      void registerUser(LoginDTO loginDTO, String ipAddress)
      Initiates the user registration process by creating a pending registration. Sends a confirmation email with a token for account activation.
      Parameters:
      loginDTO - the login data containing email and password for registration
      ipAddress - the IP address of the client initiating registration
      Throws:
      ConflictException - if the email is already registered or pending confirmation

    • confirmUser

      void confirmUser(String email, UserRegistrationDTO userRegistrationDTO)
      Completes the user registration process by confirming the email and creating the user account.
      Parameters:
      email - the email address of the user to confirm
      userRegistrationDTO - the registration data containing user details and workplace

    • changePassword

      void changePassword(String resetPasswordToken, LoginDTO loginDTO)
      Validates a resetPasswordToken and changes the password for the token owner
      Parameters:
      resetPasswordToken - The password reset token with the ID of the user whose password should be changed
      loginDTO - The login object with the new password in plain text (will be hashed)
      Throws:
      UnauthorizedException - if token is invalid

    • assignManagerBulk

      void assignManagerBulk(Long userId, ManagerAssignDTO managerAssignDto)
      Assigns a manager to multiple users in a bulk operation. Validates permissions and promotes the manager role if necessary.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the admin user performing the assignment
      managerAssignDto - the data containing manager ID and user IDs to assign

    • updateUser

      void updateUser(Long userId, UserDTO userDto)

      Boolean uploadProfilePicture(Long requesterId, Long userId, FileUploadDTO fileUploadDTO)
